reviews.verdict: Enhanced FHSkillz (jail-prompt writing guide, jail-task-contract question rounds) and added jail-questionnaire (adapted from to-questionnaire)
Enhance tried in jail-prototype 2.0; blind tests did not beat 1.2.0, so it was reverted. Review-page ideas kept in jail-py-toolkit artifact-lint.

items.name: teach
items.used_when: Use it to learn a new skill or concept yourself, step by step, in a workspace of lessons and notes.

items.name: wait-what
items.used_when: Use it when an AI answer didn't make sense: it asks for a simpler re-explanation with more context.

items.name: tdd
items.used_when: Use it on software projects to build features or fix bugs test-first (red, green, refactor).

items.name: code-review
items.used_when: Use it on software projects to review code changes against the repo's standards and the original spec, side by side.

items.name: to-tickets
items.used_when: Use it on software projects to split a plan into small tickets, each a thin working slice, with what blocks what.

items.name: wizard
items.used_when: Use it when setup steps only a person can do (dashboards, credentials) need a guided step-by-step script.

items.name: writing-fragments / writing-beats / writing-shape
items.used_when: Use it to turn rough notes into an article: collect fragments, order them into beats, then shape paragraphs. Possible fit for the book project.

items.name: git-guardrails-claude-code
items.used_when: Use it to block risky git commands (force push, hard reset) in Claude Code with hooks.
